description: LO sigma(p p > chsleptons chsleptons) versus slepton mass at 13 TeV, with chsleptons = el er mul mur ta1 ta2 (both charges each): the untagged inclusive cross section of the six-state content that the generation recipe produces. The four-state table divided by this one is 2/3, because ta1 and ta2 together make one more generation of left- and right-handed sleptons for degenerate masses.
process: p p > chsleptons chsleptons / susystrong (6 species x both charges, no ISR jet).
model: MSSM_SLHA2 with the shipped parameter template data/templates/slepton_bino_param_template.slha rendered per mass: all six charged-slepton masses = m (MSLEP) and the lightest neutralino MN1 = m-2; squarks, gluino, sneutrinos, charginos and heavier neutralinos at 4.5e9 GeV. The neutralino mass does not enter s-channel Drell-Yan production.
pdf: cteq6l1 (MadGraph-internal LO set), the PDF of the LO slepton generation recipe. A ratio of a higher-order table to this table mixes order and PDF by construction; it is a correction between the same states, not a PDF-matched k-factor.
generator: MG5_aMC 2.9.27 LO, 13 TeV pp; data/templates/madgraph_run_default_lo.dat keyed edits for nevents, iseed, ebeam1, ebeam2, pdlabel, ickkw and use_syst; nevents=2000, iseed=1, ebeam1=ebeam2=6500, pdlabel=cteq6l1, ickkw=0, use_syst=False
generated: 2026-07-04 (one-off reference run; regenerate with the recorded recipe to extend the grid)
